description: Marion, IA – Team Hinson has highlighted many of Josh Turek’s missed votes…but when Josh does actually show up, he votes like a liberal. Josh Turek is no moderate. He is just another liberal whose rhetoric does not match his voting record. On Tuesday, March 26th, 2024, Josh Turek voted to make it easier for politicians to raise taxes on Iowans. ###
